thread:
Alice: Heads-up — we're planning to land a streaming framing change for /v3/generate on Monday. It's a small wire change (metadata prefix) but will break older SDKs if clients assume the old frame shape.
Ben: Can we avoid client breakage with a gateway shim?
Carol: I'd prefer header negotiation rather than automatic transformation. Add an opt-in header `X-RW-Stream-V` so clients can indicate which framing they support.
Dan: Opt-in helps, but customers using older SDKs won't set it. Gateway-level translation seems safest short-term. We could detect old frames and translate to new format.
Alice: Translation is doable but tricky for partial frames and chunking. We also need to preserve KV cache metadata in the stream — that caused issues in the last rollout.
Ben: Proposed shim sketch: if request has `X-RW-Stream-V: v2` or lacks header, the gateway accepts v3 server frames and emits v2 frames to client. If header `v3` forward raw. Pseudocode:
```
if req.header("X-RW-Stream-V") == "v2":
  for frame in upstream:
    out = translate_v3_to_v2(frame)
    send(out)
else:
  proxy_raw()
```
Carol: Nice. We should implement translation as a small state machine so we can unit test edgecases (partial messages, multi-chunk metadata).
Dan: Also add a sampling hook to record when translation happens: `shim.translate.sampled=true` metric + trace span. We want to know how many customers still rely on v2.
Alice: Agreed. Telemetry + a canary rollout (5% region us-west-2) then 25% then global. Gate with feature flag per-tenant.
Ben: What about SDKs? We should publish a patch that sets the header automatically for new clients and add a deprecation warning in logs.
Carol: SDK change + server shim buys us ~3 months to get clients updated. After that we can flip a flag to require `v3` header and remove the translation.
Dan: Need clear cutover plan steps: (1) deploy shim to gateway with metrics (2) publish SDKs + warn (3) 1-week canary (4) ramp (5) announce hard-requirement date 8 weeks out (6) disable shim.
Alice: Also create a small test harness that simulates network splits and partial frame reassembly — last time this surfaced in prod. Put it in `eng-infra/streaming-tests`.
Ben: Who's picking the shim PR? I can take it if Carol owns the SDK patch.
Carol: I'll handle SDK PR and changelog entry. Will add automatic `X-RW-Stream-V` header on new client versions.
Dan: I'll own rollout orchestration and the canary job. I'll add telemetry dashboards: shim rate, errors, translate latency.
Alice: Sounds good. Add an RFC follow-up doc with the migration timeline and update the migration-playbook. Also ping support to prepare canned responses if customers report failures.

Ben: One more edge case — proxies that buffer entire response might drop streaming behavior. Add an integration test against common proxies (nginx sidecar with http2 chunk buffering).
Carol: noted. I'll add compatibility tests to the SDK CI matrix to run against the shim gateway.
Alice: Thanks all. Let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT if there are any blockers.
Dan: 👍 I'll post the rollout runbook draft in this thread before EOD.
Carol: I'll open the SDK PR now.
Ben: Starting gateway shim branch.
